title: A propective randomized split-mouth study with modified and conventional sandblasted acid-etched implants in irradiated oral squamous cell carcinoma patients
summary: In this study, modified dental implant surfaces are investigated with regard to faster healing in irradiated bone. The aim of the study is to examine whether the special surface of the implant types used shows advantages in this area and leads to a faster dental rehabilitation.
